qualifications: Finite 960-pixel master pupil, native 3n periodic atmosphere screens; all grids sample the same screens. The 3.66 m canvas omits frequencies below 0.273 m⁻¹, above 1/L0 = 0.033 m⁻¹; no subharmonics restore this low-frequency power. Winds travel up to 6 m in 0.6 s, reusing periodic structure. The 1440 / 256 comparison is a numerical reference, not an independent physical oracle. No detector noise or pixel quantization is applied to the host controller. Primary cases use their own calibration with a 5% singular-value cutoff and fixed gain 0.15. Optional anchors may reuse the 1440 / 256 calibration, as recorded. Science diagnostics use a common 480 grid with sparse 960 and 1440 checks. This exercises a causal host controller and plant, with no actual pyRTC integration. Timing covers only the warmed static plant endpoint; controller, atmosphere generation, transfers and science diagnostics are excluded.
